smallest_surviving_model: The strongest current model is a register-role grammar, not a phonetic decipherment. Core lane: 400 marks and usually opens the non-copper tablet/account register (TAB:B/TAB:I); 740 is the broad opener for the rectangular/copper administrative register (SEAL:R/TAB:C); 407 is an independent narrower opener/entry marker in the same rectangular/copper register; 806 is a boundary/closure pivot in that register. Secondary lane A: 002 is a preterminal bridge into a closure ecology whose strongest closers are 817, 820, and 861; 820 is a source-visible wheel/rosette terminal closer selected by a Mohenjo-daro rhinoceros square-seal packet at object level, but hostile family/page collapse demotes that packet to object-level candidate and blocks any global rhinoceros word/sign reading. Secondary lane B: 090/091 are the discoverable top pair for an external circular-seal register, not a portable all-external marker and not a phonetic bridge. Hostile leaveout makes the signal Gulf/Dilmun-weighted; pair maxstat keeps it alive inside external circular seals; Laursen's Failaka discussion shows that at least one key Failaka object is a later Dilmun-style pseudo-Indus/enigmatic emulation rather than clean Gulf Type. Susa 3881.1 is source-bound to Louvre SB 5614 as a real circular Susa bovid seal with six signs, but the exact +700-604-407-090-365-000+ sequence and 407+090 bridge remain catalog-dependent rather than source-promoted.

ranked_survivors.candidate: 400 is a non-copper tablet/account register opener, especially in TAB:B/TAB:I.
support: Re-run forger: 187/765 TAB:B/I rows carry 400 versus 100/2738 background; all-sign rank 1/714; Bonferroni p=3.631762848429207e-59; context maxstat FPR=0.
Inside TAB:B/I rows, 400 is initial in 178/190 occurrences; all-sign rank 1/306; Bonferroni p=8.44070657051313e-85; initial-position maxstat FPR=0.
Controls survive complete-only, non-poor-only, leave-Mohenjo-daro, and leave-Harappa, though without Harappa is weaker but still below 0.01.
ranked_survivors.limitation: This earns carrier/register and slot role only. It does not give a sound, lexical value, or language ID.

ranked_survivors.candidate: 740 and 407 are independent openers in the SEAL:R/TAB:C rectangular/copper administrative register.
support: Re-run forger: 740 is initial in 129/180 register occurrences, rank 1/278, Fisher p=1.3511897977632278e-52, maxstat FPR=0.
407 is initial in 34/55 register occurrences, rank 2/278, Fisher p=6.136812829050565e-11.
Collision rows are mixed: 740 before 407 in 11/19 and 407 before 740 in 8/19, killing a strict nesting hierarchy while preserving independent-opener behavior.
ranked_survivors.limitation: 407 weakens when Mohenjo-daro is left out, so expansion should source-check non-Mohenjo rectangular rows before treating 407 as pan-regional.

ranked_survivors.candidate: 407 and 806 split opener versus boundary/closure roles inside the same SEAL:R/TAB:C register.
support: Re-run forger: in 444 canonical SEAL:R/TAB:C rows, 407 has 34/55 initial occurrences and 0/55 boundary-next occurrences; 806 has 3/51 initial occurrences and 29/51 boundary-next occurrences.
Direct 407-vs-806 initial Fisher p=3.7369995725383713e-10; direct 806-vs-407 boundary Fisher p=1.7478476262987026e-12.
Ordered-pair and frequency-matched maxstat FPRs are both 0 under the row-preserving forger.
ranked_survivors.limitation: Co-occurrence support is only five rows, with one nested counter-order row. The role split is strong at occurrence level but should be tested on held-out source-visible rows.

ranked_survivors.candidate: 407 marks a broader rectangular/copper administrative register spanning SEAL:R and TAB:C.
support: Re-run forger: 53/444 SEAL:R/TAB:C register rows carry 407 versus 17/3059 background; all-sign rank 1/714; Bonferroni p=1.2618252646220003e-31; maxstat FPR=0.
Survives complete-only, non-poor-only, leave-Mohenjo-daro, and leave-Harappa controls.
Support is not only Mohenjo-daro: Harappa, Dholavira, Lothal, Desalpur, Nausharo, and Susa all contribute at least one 407 row.
ranked_survivors.limitation: Susa 3881.1 is the only external circular 407 row and its 407+090 sequence remains catalog-dependent, so this does not yet bridge the internal register model to Meluhha/Gulf phonetics.
